firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hey team!

We are super excited you're here with us on Kaggle to learn more and participate in ARC Prize 2026: ARC-AGI-3 edition. Our #1 goal is to make sure you have the tools, knowledge, and support you need to start solving ARC-AGI.

Here is a [guide](https://arcprize.org/competitions/2026/arc-agi-3) to help you get started. In addition to the Kaggle templates, track our [community leaderboard](https://arcprize.org/leaderboard/community) and [documentation](https://docs.arcprize.org/) to get you up to speed.

Plug into the community & get competition updates:
* [Subscribe to the newsletter](https://arcprize.kit.com/bc80575d89)
* [Join the Discord server](https://discord.gg/9b77dPAmcA)
* [Follow ARC Prize Twitter](https://twitter.com/arcprize)
* [Subscribe on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@arcprize)

Have questions? Feel free to start a discussion topic on this competition, reach out to us on Twitter, Discord, or team@arcprize.org.

Greg Kamradt, President, ARC Prize Foundation
